verdict.rationale: Box documents a real REST API at https://api.box.com/2.0 with OAuth 2.0 auth and a working curl example, and it documents a Chunked Upload API for files. That covers the REST foundation and the upload leg of the story. The pack never explicitly documents download, list-folder, move, or delete endpoints. A webhook firing on file download and read-only shared links are adjacent features, not file-operation endpoints, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented download, list, move and delete endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration of the files API.
